title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode2 The Life I Wanted

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I heard someone calling my name just now...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“What are you saying?
Our next class is about to start.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “Haha. Mr. Hermut's history lectures are usually pretty boring, so I don't blame you for dozing off.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They're speaking German...?
And the view outside this window...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
“Are you sure you're feeling okay, Toya?
You really seem out of it.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “Wait, you're not sick, are you?! Now I feel terrible for waking you!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I was...having a bit of an odd dream just now.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, so I'm glad you woke me up.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Mr. Hermut's lectures are very interesting, so I'd rather not miss a second of it.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“You're such a good student, Toya!
Are all kids in Japan like you?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I can't speak for my peers, but... I suppose we are a studious bunch.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Plus, I'm here because I chose to be.”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
“Rationalism and natural science.
As these two schools of thought gained traction throughout Europe, people's core values began to change.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been in Vienna as an exchange student for a while now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Keeping up with these lectures has been challenging, but I know I'm receiving a high-quality education.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And Mom is the reason why I've been able to focus on my studies like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You stayed out late again? Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Let me guess. You were at an arcade or some other frivolous place.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: How many times do I have to tell you that you can't afford to waste time like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father's Voice
rows.Line: Just when I thought that he'd given up on that nonsense music, he's still acting like a hooligan. Not only can't I hold a decent conversation with him, he refuses to have dinner with us...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father's Voice
rows.Line: Honestly, what does that boy want to do with his life?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Now I know.
Neither classical nor street music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I...wasn't meant to pursue either of them in the first place.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been surrounded by music my entire life and told that I had to become a musician...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm being lambasted here every day.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even though I can't do anything anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even breathing is hard for me at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I no longer belong in this house.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
I brought you your dinner.
I'll leave it right here, so please have however much you feel like.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: There's something I've been meaning to ask you for a little while now...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: How would you like to go somewhere new...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After Mom suggested that to me, I immediately decided to leave home and live with Natsuomi.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not only do I enjoy learning new things, but foreign cultures have always interested me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can focus on studying without having to worry about anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Natsuomi is still performing in that concert.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd cause him a lot of trouble by moving in with him...but he's been so busy that we haven't actually seen each other all that much.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That might be to both our benefits.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, I should start making dinner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The meat's too chewy. I think I overcooked it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And the soup tastes bland...
I also should've cut these vegetables into smaller, bite-sized pieces. I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I never would've imagined being able to cook my own meals when I was still playing classical music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that sense, I feel like I've made quite a bit of progress in terms of learning to lead a normal life.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to believe...that I made the right choice.
